dedupe_keys.name: dataset modular impedance matrix method for transient modeling in pipe network systems

description: Sanghyun Kim at Pusan National University publishes reference material for a modular impedance-matrix method for pipe-network transients. The October 2023 deposit lists six Excel workbooks named for study figures and a PowerPoint figure file, freely available under CC BY 4.0. The study description discusses frequency-domain modelling with time-domain responses and comparison with existing methods in a field network. The visible inventory establishes numerical figure data and a diagram, not a complete implementation of the proposed solver. Site coverage, event periods, sample spacing, units and workbook schemas remain unknown from the public metadata. A modeller could use the tabulated results to compare transient pressure or flow simulations once variables and boundary conditions are confirmed. The provider's claims about computational advantages were not independently tested. No related catalogue record explicitly identifies these reference outputs, and the spreadsheets were not opened.
